title: The experiment pilot can run only once, cannot extend enrollment, and can lose or rewrite its own result
detail: Found reading the pilot code for LIVE-2281; no pilot has run, so nothing is lost yet. CONFIRMED in source: (1) analytics_experiment_manage has no path out of completed and the key is unique, so the one catalog pilot can be run once ever; an inconclusive run on thin traffic spends it. (2) Assignment stops at started_at + minimum_days and pause does not stop that clock, so a slow week cannot be extended. (3) finish stamps guardrails_reviewed_at = now() at enrollment close, before the 7-day follow-up the review is supposed to cover exists. (4) The 180-day retention purge deletes assignments, which fires the exclusion trigger, so a completed result can later read as inconclusive (lib/analytics/experiments.ts). LIKELY, not yet proven: (5) recordConfirmedRsvp is called un-awaited from app/(main)/events/actions.ts and the outcome path then reads cookies() in lib/analytics/experiment-runtime.ts, which can fail silently once the response is sent, losing the outcome. (6) lib/analytics/rsvp-telemetry.ts skips the outcome when the idempotent event.rsvp row already exists, so a member who RSVPed before exposure never converts. WHY IT MATTERS: the first real pilot after launch would produce a result nobody can trust or repeat. FIX DIRECTION: an additive migration that lets a completed key be re-drafted as a new run (run number in the seed), stops the clock while paused, records the guardrail review as its own later command, and snapshots arm totals at completion so the purge cannot change them; await the outcome write inside the request (after()) and count a first post-exposure RSVP. Fix before LIVE-2281 starts a pilot.

verify.evidence: Fails today: the six points above read true in the cited files. Passes when a pgTAP test shows a completed pilot can be re-run, a paused pilot keeps its remaining enrollment days, guardrail review is recorded after follow-up, and a purge leaves a completed result unchanged, and a unit test shows the RSVP outcome is awaited within the request.
